items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Louis Armstrong I heard the Greystone

ctx.x: There was a place called the Greystone Ballroom. There was also a place called Wall Lake Casino. It was about 18 miles outside of Detroit at a lake, Wall Lake.

It was a big dancing casino there. A lot of the big bands played there. Most of the bands played at the Greystone Ballroom. I heard Earl Hines there. I heard Earl Hines in Flint Michigan by the way. Louis Armstrong I heard the Greystone, Count Basie, and let's see, who else? Actually, those with… Lester I didn't hear there. I never saw Lester's band in person, but they made some good records. The Greystone ballroom was the kind of place most of the big bands played.
This was in what period? What was in the late 40s or early 50s?
